description: Get the full stack trace (stacktrace) of one thread in a Sentry event, such as a non-crashed thread listed in the issue details. Lists the threads when the selector matches none or several. For an event with no threads, returns its event-level stacktrace.

eventId.description: An event ID in the issue, or `latest`.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

thread.description: Numeric thread ID or exact thread name from the issue details. Omit for Sentry's default: the crashed thread, else the first with a stack trace.

name: get_event_stacktrace

availableThreads.description: Every thread on the event, listed only when the `thread` selector matched none or several.

platform.description: The event platform, which sets how to read frames.

message.description: Why no thread was selected; null when one was.

status.description: `selected` returns `thread`. Otherwise `thread` is null and `message` says why.

frames.description: Most recent call last. The most relevant frame is the last in-app frame.

absPath.description: Present only when it differs from filename.

postContext.description: Up to 3 source lines after lineNo, on the most relevant frame only.

preContext.description: Up to 3 source lines before lineNo, on the most relevant frame only.

vars.description: Local variables, on the most relevant frame only. Values longer than 200 characters of JSON are cut to a string.

stacktrace.description: The event-level stacktrace, when the event has no threads but has a stack outside them, as on a captured message.

frames.description: Most recent call last. The most relevant frame is the last in-app frame.

absPath.description: Present only when it differs from filename.

postContext.description: Up to 3 source lines after lineNo, on the most relevant frame only.

preContext.description: Up to 3 source lines before lineNo, on the most relevant frame only.

vars.description: Local variables, on the most relevant frame only. Values longer than 200 characters of JSON are cut to a string.

thread.description: The selected thread and its stacktrace.

title: Get Event Stacktrace
